Bill.BriefDescription: Logging the telephone calls of residents of the special commitment center.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to logging the telephone calls of residents of thespecial commitment center; and adding a new section to chapter 71.09RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall maintain a log of phone calls made byresidents of the special commitment center. The log shall indicate thedate and time when each phone call was made, the length of the call,the name of the resident who made the call, and the number called.
